question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
-- Build the full query step by step
WITH first_payment_per_customer AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, p.payment_date, p.rental_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date ASC) as rn
    FROM payment p
),
first_rentals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, rental_id
    FROM first_payment_per_customer
    WHERE rn = 1
),
first_rental_films AS (
    SELECT fr.customer_id, f.rating
    FROM first_rentals fr
    JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rental_counts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as total_rentals
    FROM rental
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT frf.rating,
       AVG(ct.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
       AVG(crc.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rental_films frf
JOIN customer_totals ct ON frf.customer_id = ct.customer_id
JOIN customer_rental_counts crc ON frf.customer_id = crc.customer_id
GROUP BY frf.rating
ORDER BY frf.rating
